gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.007033 40.745807)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] < 40 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH poi_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-74.007033, 40.745807), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
raster_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Distance(
      poi.geom,
      ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_PointOnSurface(ST_Clip(r.rast, true, ST_Buffer(poi.geom::geometry, 0.01))), 4326), 4326)::geography
    ) AS distance_meters
  FROM
    poi_geom AS poi,
    public.dem_us AS r
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, ST_Buffer(poi.geom::geometry, 0.01))
    AND ST_Value(r.rast, ST_PointOnSurface(ST_Clip(r.rast, true, ST_Buffer(poi.geom::geometry, 0.01)))) < 40
  ORDER BY distance_meters
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT distance_meters FROM raster_analysis;
